name: haunt-client

scripts.build:prepare: node scripts/check-dm-crypto.mjs && node scripts/check-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-emoji-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-emojis.mjs --check && npm run generate && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @haunt/core
scripts.build: npm run build:prepare && vite build && node scripts/licenses.mjs
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build:prepare && vite build --mode standalone && node scripts/licenses.mjs dist-standalone && node scripts/package-web.mjs
scripts.package:desktop:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs arm64
scripts.package:sdk: npm run generate && npm run build -w @haunt/core && mkdir -p release && npm pack -w @haunt/core --pack-destination release
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts electron-app/*.cjs electron-app/*.json electron-builder.config.json tests/*.ts vite.config.ts
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.electron:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:win: npm run build && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.electron:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.buildreplace:electron: npm run electron:mac; pkill -f Haunt; cp -rf release/builder/mac-arm64/Haunt.app /Applications/; sign.sh /Applications/Haunt.app; open /Applications/Haunt.app
scripts.replace:electron: pkill -f Haunt; cp -rf release/builder/mac-arm64/Haunt.app /Applications/; sign.sh /Applications/Haunt.app; open /Applications/Haunt.app

description: Haunt — self-hosted community messaging and calls
author: Haunt
